messages:
Alicia: Quick unblock request  AtlasBank POC: Rust streaming client fails behind their corporate TLS inspection. They also need a compact example of func/tool JSON for payment ops and a 1k TPS burst cost ballpark. Can someone pick up?

Sam: I'll take point. Mino, can you draft a tiny Rust example and note the TLS workaround?

Mino: Yep. Short guidance: either have Atlas allowlist our egress IPs or provide a CA bundle to the SDK for the POC. Minimal websocket send/receive example: 

`use tokio_tungstenite::connect_async; async fn s() { let (mut ws,_) = connect_async("wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream").await.unwrap(); ws.send("{\"prompt\":\"charge $12.50 to acct:987\"}").await.unwrap(); while let Some(m)=ws.next().await { println!("{}", m.unwrap()); } }`

Mino: Tool JSON sample to return from model: `{"tool":"create_charge","args":{"amount_cents":1250,"currency":"USD","trace_id":"atlas-2026-03-21-xyz"}}`

Jordan: If allowlist not possible we can issue short-lived mTLS certs for the POC or spin a staging edge in a region outside their proxy. Also note: their proxy drops idle websockets at 30s  use app-level pings every 15s.

Nina: Security quick: hosted uses AWS KMS (HSM-backed). We support BYOK for Dedicated/Private. SOC2 Type II docs available; will share link.

Kevin: Pricing ballpark for 1k TPS bursts (~150 tokens avg): hosted burst estimate $18k-$32k/month; Dedicated reserved for steady 1k TPS ~$60k-$85k/month. Can refine with traffic shape.

Alicia: Thanks  scheduling handoff call tomorrow 9am PT. Sam and Mino please join; I'll send invite and attach the tiny runbook.
